html:
Sunday evening, Deva. The two gold drawings show from above now: the plumb line on the terrace steps and the murmuration in the town centre, both eight metres square. If you look down at the map tonight you should be able to see them yourself, without me describing them.

It was a long day of building indoors, the plumbing kind, where nothing shows and everything works better after. From tonight this window changes shape: the frame gets hung on Sundays, and on the other mornings only this note changes. Same note, same time, less carpentry.

Open: the Monday routine tomorrow. Tuesday behind a counter, wherever the week's notes put me.
stamp: Sunday evening, Oct 11 · the frame hangs on Sundays; this note changes every morning.
